sections.title: Introduction
paragraphs: Thank you for shopping with Vismayam Arts. This Shipping Policy explains how orders placed through vismayamarts.in are processed and delivered.

sections.title: Order Processing
paragraphs: Orders are processed after payment confirmation. Processing time may vary depending on product availability, order volume, and the nature of the product.
bullets: Please ensure that your shipping address and contact details are accurate.
Orders may require additional processing time during holidays or promotional periods.
We may contact you if additional information is required to process your order.

sections.title: Shipping and Delivery
paragraphs: Delivery timelines depend on the destination, courier service, product availability, and other factors outside our control.
bullets: Delivery estimates, where provided, are indicative and are not guaranteed.
Courier delays caused by weather, public holidays, or other unforeseen circumstances may affect delivery.
Please make sure someone is available to receive the shipment at the delivery address.

sections.title: Shipping Charges
paragraphs: Applicable shipping charges, if any, will be displayed during checkout before you complete your order.

sections.title: Damaged or Missing Packages
paragraphs: If your package arrives damaged or an item appears to be missing, please contact us with your order details and supporting photographs so we can review the issue.

sections.title: Contact Us
paragraphs: For shipping-related questions, contact Vismayam Arts using the contact details provided on our website.

sections.title: Introduction
paragraphs: Vismayam Arts respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information may be collected when you use vismayamarts.in and how that information may be used.

sections.title: Information We May Collect
paragraphs: Depending on how you use our website, information may include:
bullets: Name and contact details provided during checkout or account registration.
Shipping and billing information needed to process an order.
Order details and customer service communications.
Technical information such as browser, device, and website usage data.

sections.title: How Information May Be Used
paragraphs: Information may be used to:
bullets: Process and fulfil orders.
Communicate order updates and respond to enquiries.
Provide customer support.
Maintain website security and improve website functionality.
Meet applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

sections.title: Sharing of Information
paragraphs: Information may be shared with service providers involved in operating the website or fulfilling your order, such as payment, delivery, hosting, or customer support providers, where necessary for those purposes.

sections.title: Data Security
paragraphs: We take reasonable measures to protect information. However, no method of electronic transmission or storage can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

sections.title: Cookies and Similar Technologies
paragraphs: Our website may use cookies or similar technologies to support website functionality and understand usage. You can manage cookies through your browser settings, although disabling certain cookies may affect website features.

sections.title: Your Choices
paragraphs: You may contact us to ask questions about personal information you have provided or to request assistance, subject to applicable law and our ability to verify your request.

sections.title: Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The latest version will be published on this page.

sections.title: Contact Us
paragraphs: For privacy-related questions, please contact Vismayam Arts using the contact details provided on our website.
